<translate>
<!--T:5-->
The '''Flying Nimbus''' is a fast rideable cloud. '''Only the pure of heart can ride it''': if your [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] isn't good enough, it won't carry you. Its darker counterpart, the '''Black Nimbus''', only carries riders with an '''evil heart'''.
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting a cloud == <!--T:6-->

<!--T:7-->
Ask [[Special:MyLanguage/Korin|Korin]] at [[Special:MyLanguage/Kami's Lookout|Kami's Lookout]] for his '''Flying Nimbus''' service:

<!--T:8-->
* if your alignment is above 50, he gives you a Flying Nimbus;
* otherwise, he gives you a Black Nimbus.

<!--T:9-->
He only gives you a cloud if you don't already carry one, and once he has given you a cloud the service stays locked.
</translate>

<translate>
== Riding == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
* Right-click a block with the cloud to place it, then right-click the cloud to get on.
* The '''Flying Nimbus''' only lets you ride with an alignment of '''67 or more'''; otherwise the cloud rejects you. The '''Black Nimbus''' rejects riders with an alignment of 67 or more.
* Steer with the mouse and the movement keys. Hold {{Key|Space}} to rise and the Second Function key ({{Key|Left Alt}} by default) to descend. Both clouds fly at 24 blocks per second and rise or descend at 8.
* Press the Dash key ({{Key|R}} by default) for a short burst of speed.
* The Flying Nimbus carries up to '''2''' riders: the one in front steers, and riders switch seats with the Technique Slot 1 and 2 keys ({{Key|Alt}} + {{Key|1}} / {{Key|2}} by default). The Black Nimbus carries one. Neither takes fall damage.
* You can't fire techniques while riding a cloud, and [[Special:MyLanguage/Fly|Fly]] switches off when you get on.
* The cloud leaves a trail behind it as it flies.
* Hit the cloud to pick it back up as an item. Any player can pick up any cloud.
* The clouds share their controls and rules with every other [[Special:MyLanguage/Vehicles|vehicle]].
</translate>
